name: audit_secondary_major_section_empty
label: Education (UIUC): Secondary Major
spec_quote: A label may be "Section (entry): Field", e.g. "Education (UIUC): Secondary Major" — only the part after the colon is the question. A label is a SECOND-major question when it contains (case-insensitive) "second", "secondary", "double", "additional", "2nd" or "other" directly followed by "major", "discipline", "field", "field of study" or "concentration"; or the word "minor"; or "major 2" / "major #2" / "major two". Second-major question, value empty or none-like ("None", "N/A", "n/a", "NA", "Not applicable", "No minor", "No second major", "-") → no education_field mismatch.
